full_text: Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT A. Francisco Gold Condominium II Bldg, EDSA corner Mapagmahal St., Diliman, Quezon City LEGAL SERVICE OPINION NO. 84 S. 2010 02 June 2010 GOVERNOR DEOGRACIAS VICTOR B. SAVELLANO Ilocos Sur Dear Governor Savellano: This has reference to your earlier letter asking this Department's legal opinion on the effectivity of Resolution No. 053, series of 2009 approving your Appropriations Ordinance No. 02-09, which was already signed by all of the members present but not with the signature of the Presiding Officer. In reply thereto, please be informed that this Department had already answered a similar query in DILG Opinion No. 07, series ore007. In the said legal opinion, we opined that the attestation or certification by the Presiding Officer on an ordinance is not one of the substantive requirements in the passage of an ordinance. Being a matter of procedure, the lack of it should not affect the legality of the subject ordinance. Thus, even without the attestation of the Presiding Officer, if the ordinance can be certified to be true and correct by some other officials present in the session, such as the Secretary to the Sanggunian, there is already a substantial compliance with the procedural process of enacting an ordinance. Hereto attached is a photocopy of the aforesaid DILG Opinion for your ready perusal. Thank you and warm regards. Ls/17 (4 Very truly yours, BY AUTHORIT( OF THE SECRETARY: . JESUS 111 Dire
